_comment: Hand-maintained rules the bootstrap-static API lacks (PLAN §3 Rules config), read together with 2026-27.json by fplopt.backtest.rules.load_rules. Every key without a _comment suffix is required.

defcon_threshold._comment: Count needed for the defensive-contribution award: DEF clearances+blocks+interceptions+tackles (CBIT), MID/FWD CBIT + recoveries (CBIRT); GK not eligible (null).

transfers.chip_week_ft_comment: Banked FTs after a Wildcard/Free Hit GW: 'retain_plus_one' (kept, +1 as in any GW) or 'retain' (kept, no +1). Verified 2026-10-06 (#9): 795 top-800 2026/27 entry histories (507 played WC/FH in GW2-5) are all consistent with 'retain'; 'retain_plus_one' is contradicted by 27 (hits paid with FTs it says were left).
transfers.ft_topups_comment: Extra FTs granted at a GW, as [{"gw_index": n, "amount": k}]. 2026/27 has no AFCON top-up (PLAN §3).

chips.freehit_consecutive_comment: Free Hit may not be played in consecutive GWs (2025/26 rule; VERIFY for 2026/27, PLAN §11).
